messages:
anya: Noticed a small but steady uptick in token truncation/errors for titan-q1 in eu-west during the evening deploy window (~2.8% on canary). Suspect a runtime->model binding mismatch after yesterday's kernel update. Thinking a region-scoped runtime hold while we triage. :thinking:

robert: Region-only hold SGTM. Can we avoid touching model pins? If we hold runtime, add a temporary client advisory so integrators don't auto-upgrade SDKs that change marshaling.

nina: FYI the SDK 4.1 change to sequence framed headers is likely the culprit. SDK 4.2 contains a backwards-compatible header flag but it won't publish until we've validated the shim. Suggest: 1) apply runtime hold in eu-west for titan-q1; 2) block auto-uninstall/upgrades of SDK 4.1 in that region; 3) route 15% traffic to titan-q1-lite fallback.

deploybot: Automated: hold applied -> scope=runtime:v4.5, model=titan-q1, region=eu-west, id=hold-1767003210, started=2026-03-25T18:12Z. Auto-unfreeze disabled while advisory open.

oncall-bot: Alert: token_truncation_rate 2.8% -> triggered. Monitoring window extended to 25m.

anya: Pushed routing change: `route_set region=eu-west model=titan-q1 split={primary:85, fallback-lite:15}`. Also added a tenant allowlist for customers on older SDKs.

eng-platform: Drafted release note: "eu-west: runtime hold for runtime v4.5 affecting titan-q1 due to header framing mismatch with SDK 4.1. Mitigation: upgrade to SDK 4.2 (shim) or use fallback titan-q1-lite. Hold will be lifted after SDK 4.2 is published and one healthy canary cycle post-publish."

qa: Will run a short synthetic suite against titan-q1-lite and the shimmed SDK 4.2 canary. ETA 40m. Will post results here.

robert: Also recommend we set the unfreeze policy to require eng-releases + qa signoff, and a verification window of 2 consecutive healthy canary cycles. Avoid auto-unfreeze.

anya: Agreed. Leaving hold in place. Manual unfreeze: `/hold remove hold-1767003210` (requires eng-releases + qa). I'll update once QA clears the smoke. :white_check_mark:
